svg.desc: You: How much did I pay for the last HVAC repair? Shadow: Latest matching receipt: $480. June 12, 2026 · marked paid. Source: “Example HVAC — repair receipt.” You: Does that include the follow-up reminder? Shadow: The reminder is for the same repair, not another payment. The receipt shows $480.
